title: Group of Seven (G7) Host Year Integrated Event Management, Production, and Logistical Support
description:
Amendment  2 

 The purpose of this amendment is to correct and update the Government's responses to industry questions previously provided. Please refer to the revised Questions and Answers document attached to this amendment for details. 

 ___________ 

 Amendment 1  

 Purpose of this amendment is to extend the reply by date to 12/02/2026 and to respond to questions. See question and answer document for details.  

 ___________ 

 The Treasury Common Services Center (TCSC), on behalf of the U.S. Department of Treasury, is soliciting Small Business authorized vendors for integrated event management, production, destination management, and logistical support for the United States G7 Host Year requirement for the products and services described in the Statement of Work. 

 This requirement is a 100% Small Business set-aside under NAICS code 561920. 

 The Government anticipates awarding a Firm-Fixed-Priced (FFP) BPA resulting from this solicitation using the best-value approach. 

 The Government intends to select ONE contractor for award. It is the responsibility of each offeror to submit a quote that complies with all aspects of this solicitation to include completion of the Provisions section, Accessibility Conformance Report and any other requested documents or verifications. 

 Questions shall be submitted electronically via email no later than 10:00 (10:00 AM EST) Wednesday November 18, 2026. 

 Interested offerors shall submit quotes electronically via email no later than 10:00 (10:00 AM EST) Wednesday, November 25, 2026. Quotes shall contain all information as listed in the Instruction to Offerors. 

 Period of Performance:   Will consist of one (1) twelve-month base period with an anticipated period of performance from the date of award through 12-months.
